question: Which of the following English cricketers was NOT a part of the Test Match that India won by 151 runs at Lords in August 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Stuart Broad.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Stuart Broad was not part of the test match squad of England at Lords in August 2021 in which India defeated England by 151.**
 
• This was India's third test match win at lords having won earlier in the 1986 and 2014 series.
